title: The polo on the line
logline: The maroon polo on a clothesline behind the tavern in November, alone, drying in weather that won't dry it. Eleven years of it. The page draws the shirt as the shift.

panels.composition: A maroon polo shirt pinned alone on a clothesline behind a tavern in November drizzle, the garage door beyond, gray.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a maroon polo shirt pinned alone on a clothesline behind a tavern in November drizzle with a garage door beyond, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
